ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.blurb: Humans are restless, adaptable, and ambitious, at home anywhere and finished nowhere.
bloodlines: Allies within 15 feet gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their first Defense roll each round while they can see or hear you.

cultures: A lowland order-state where nothing is real until it is written and witnessed. Serrovane settles its disputes by formal challenge, keeps its ledgers in triplicate, and considers a broken oath a more serious crime than the violence that follows it.
The trade-towns of a wide river delta, where six languages meet at every dock and a good broker is worth more than a good sword. Reach folk talk first, and are very good at it.
backgrounds: In a circus or on the streets, you earned your pay by performing as an acrobat.
You served in somebody's army, and learned what a line looks like just before it breaks.
You made your living outside the law, and still know who to ask.
callings: Sneak Attack: +1d6 precision damage vs. Off-Guard foes, rising to +4d6 at Legendary.
Rage: Temp HP = level + Might, +2 melee damage, −1 Evade, and you are Heedless while it lasts.
Panache: held on a critical Strike, a Feint, or a Demoralize; +1 Evade and +5 ft Speed while you hold it.
Mark Prey: +1d8 precision damage the first time each round you Hit your prey, and you always know roughly where it is.
Drilled: Weapon Familiarity free, +2 to your Weapons Proficiency Bonus with that group, and Reactive Strike without its requirements.
postures: +2 circumstance bonus to Evade for the triggering attack. A Zone of your choice becomes Exposed immediately, win or lose.
+2 circumstance bonus to Guard for the triggering attack. A Zone of your choice becomes Exposed immediately, win or lose.

actionTraits: Attack
Counts toward your multiple attack penalty, and suffers it. Your first attack in a turn is unpenalized, your second takes −5, and your third and beyond take −10.
Move
You change position under your own power. Moving out of a foe's reach may provoke a reaction from anyone who has a Talent that allows it.
Manipulate
You use your hands. You need at least one free, and fine work near an enemy can provoke a reaction from them.
Concentrate
Actions and Activities with this Trait take an extra action to complete if you are Heedless.
Stance
A way of standing and holding yourself. You can be in only one stance at a time, and it lasts until you leave it, fall unconscious, or enter another.
Press

You may use it only while you are already suffering a multiple attack penalty, and never on someone else's turn. Some press actions add an effect on a failure; that effect never applies on a critical failure.
Auditory
It works through sound. It fails on the deafened, and on anyone who cannot hear you.
Visual
It works through sight. It fails on the blinded, and on anyone who cannot see you.
Mental
It works on the mind. It fails on anything mindless.
Emotion
A mental effect that works on feeling. Anything immune to emotion ignores it.
Reaction
Not a Trait so much as a cost: it happens on someone else's turn, and you have one per round.

Moving: Move 3 feet. Step has no Traits at all, which is the point: it never provokes reactions. You cannot Step into difficult terrain.
Jump 10 feet horizontally or 3 feet vertically, without a check. Longer or higher jumps are an Athletics check, and count as part of the Leap.
An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move a quarter of your Speed (half on a critical success). On a critical failure you fall.
An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move a quarter of your Speed (half on a critical success). On a critical failure you sink.

Acrobatics against the target's Awareness Threshold, to move through a foe's space. On a success you pass through, though their space is difficult terrain for this move. On a failure your movement stops in front of them.

Requirements You are entering a space narrower than your token size, but at least half as wide.
Move up to 5 feet, regardless of your Speed. While any part of you is in that space you are Off-Guard, Evade is unavailable, and you can attack only with Close weapons. A space narrower than half your own stops you entirely: for a Medium creature, a gap of 1½ feet or less.
Attacking:
Attack with a weapon or an unarmed blow. Roll Weapons against Evade or Guard, and deal damage and effects as normal.
◆◆ A deliberate attack. On a critical hit, you may Expose a plausible zone. ◆◆◆ A committed attack. On a hit or a critical hit, you may Expose a plausible zone.

Athletics against Evade or Guard. Needs a free hand or a Grapple weapon; target within reach and at most one Size larger.
Critical Success Restrained until the end of your next turn. Success Grabbed until the end of your next turn. Graze No effect, but the defender still pays the Graze cost. Miss You overcommit and are Off-Guard.
◆◆ Tackle. Stride, then Grapple; success also knocks them Prone and you fall Prone adjacent.

Athletics against Evade or Guard. Needs a free hand or a Shove weapon.
Critical Success Pushed 6 feet; you may Stride with it. Success Pushed 3 feet. Graze No effect, but the Graze cost still lands. Miss Off-Guard.
◆◆ Heave. 12 feet on a critical success, 6 on a success.

Athletics against Evade or Guard. Needs a free hand or a Trip weapon.
Critical Success Prone, plus damage equal to your Might. Success Prone. Graze No effect, but the Graze cost still lands. Miss Off-Guard.
Special If the target's Legs are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.
◆◆ Leg Sweep. Also leaves them Exposed [Legs].

Athletics against Evade or Guard. Needs a free hand or a Disarm weapon.
Critical Success The item drops in one of their squares. Success Grip loosened: −2 to attacks with it, and the next Disarm ignores your multiple attack penalty, until they Interact to resettle it. Graze No effect, but the Graze cost still lands. Miss Off-Guard.
Special If the target's Arms are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.
◆◆◆ Wrench. A critical success throws it 1d10 squares.

Athletics against Evade or Guard. Needs a free hand, or you are already Grabbing them.
Critical Success Move them 6 feet, staying within your reach. Success 3 feet. Graze No effect, but the Graze cost still lands. Miss They may move you 3 feet instead.
◆◆ Haul. Stride at full Speed on a critical success, half on a success, bringing them with you.
Defending & recovering: Gain your shield's item bonus to Guard until the start of your next turn. You must be wielding it.
Gather yourself: clear every Exposed zone on you.

Requirements You have Cover, or Greater Cover, or are wielding a tower shield.
Press yourself into your cover. Your Cover improves by one grade. Adjust the Zones Covered to match. This lasts until you Move, Step, or Attack.

Readying costs one action more than the action you are readying. Name a single action and a trigger. Until the start of your next turn, if the trigger occurs you may take that action as a reaction. Readying consumes your reaction whether or not it fires.

Requirements You are Grabbed or Restrained.
Roll your best of Athletics or Acrobatics against the grabber's Endure.
Critical Success Free, and you may Step as a free action. Success Free. Failure The condition persists. Critical Failure Their hold improves: Grabbed becomes Restrained.

Taken at the start of your turn, before anything else. Give up the rest of your turn, and your reaction until you act. At the end of any other creature's turn this round you may take your turn; your new place in the order stays there for the encounter. Delaying ends anything that would have ended on your turn.
Watching, deceiving & helping:
One Awareness roll against the Stealth of anything Hiding, or a Threshold the GM sets. Covers everything within 30 feet.
Critical Success The creature moves two states toward Observed. Success One state: Undetected to Hidden, Hidden to Concealed, Concealed to Observed. Failure You learn nothing. Critical Failure You commit to the wrong place and are Wrong-Footed to it until the start of your next turn.

Requirements You have at least Lesser Cover, or Concealment.
One Stealth roll against the Awareness of every creature around you, allies included.
Critical Success Hidden, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your next turn. Success Hidden. Failure They still see you. Critical Failure You have drawn the eye: Wrong-Footed to them.

Requirements You are, or believe you are, at least Hidden from one creature.
Move up to half your Speed while staying Hidden. You must end with Concealment or at least Lesser Cover from each creature you wish to stay Hidden from.
◆◆ Creep. On a failure you realize you would be seen, and may choose not to move after all.
Indicate a creature you have located. It becomes Hidden rather than Undetected, or Concealed rather than Hidden, to any ally who can hear or see you.

Intimidation against the target's Guard.
Critical Success Frightened 2. Success Frightened 1. Failure Nothing. Critical Failure It is emboldened: +1 to its Attacks against you until the end of its next turn.
◆◆ Break Them. Frightened 3 and Heedless on a critical success; Frightened 1 even on a failure.

Guile against the target's Awareness.
Critical Success Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your next turn. Success Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your turn. Failure Nothing. Critical Failure You overcommit and are Wrong-Footed to it.

Prepare ◆ on your turn, naming one ally and the task. When they attempt it before your next turn, spend your reaction to roll a relevant check against Threshold 15.
Critical Success +2 circumstance bonus. Success +1. Failure Nothing. Critical Failure They take −1. Your preparation is spent whether or not they attempt it.

A Lore or relevant Skill check against your target's level-based Threshold. Topics include Defense Thresholds, Protection and armor materials, Weaknesses, Resistances and Immunities, Attack Thresholds, Special Abilities, and maximum Hit Points.
Critical Success All facts about two topics. Success One topic. Failure Nothing. Critical Failure All the wrong facts about one topic.
Special Once per target per Skill, so several Lores give several angles.
Handling things: Draw or stow a weapon, open a door, pull a potion from your pack, pick something up, work a lever.
Drop or let go of something you are holding.
Special: Name one creature or object you Observe. Until the start of your next turn you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Defenses against its Visual effects, and it is Concealed to you.

Trigger You fall past an edge, ledge, or handhold within your reach. Requirements A hand free; you may Release ◇ to free one.
Athletics or Acrobatics against Threshold 15.
Critical Success You catch it and pull up. Success You hang there, Off-Guard. Failure You fall, reduced by 10 feet. Critical Failure You fall the full distance.

explorationActions: When an encounter begins, you can roll Awareness.
When an encounter begins, you can roll Athletics.
Roll an Awareness check; the GM applies it to the Thresholds to spot hidden objects and creatures.
Every ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative, and you may Step as a free action when you roll initiative.
Your shield begins Raised and a weapon is already in hand.
Roll a relevant Lore or Skill check to recall information about your surroundings, and roll it again for initiative if the encounter is related.

Requirements No weapon with Reach greater than Adjacent, and worn armor totalling Load 1 or less.
Roll Guile for Initiative against each enemy's Awareness. On a success they are Wrong-Footed to your first attack; on a critical success, until the end of your first turn.
downtimeActions: Move 1 already spent Talent Point to another Talent you qualify for. You cannot retrain away from a Talent in your Origin Constellation, a Root Talent, a Talent that another Talent you own requires, or a Talent that would reduce your Proficiency Rank.
You work with a teacher, a rival, or a manual. A Constellation of your choice becomes Flared. Only once between Milestones.
Buy and sell in a settlement. Common goods are simply available. For anything uncommon, roll a relevant Skill or Lore against a Threshold the GM sets. You sell at half price.

Lose the next N actions; may carry over across turns.

−1 to Evade and Guard; can't use Exploration Mode Activities.
Take it at end of each turn; Endure check (10 + the level of the effect + the amount you just took) to end.

That Zone's Protection counts as 0 and ordinary Hits can land there instead of your Torso. Recenter ◆ to clear.
Cannot see. Cannot Observe any creature. Is Off-Guard.
Cannot hear. Immune to any Auditory Action or Activity.
You have 0 Hit Points, you drop everything you are holding, and you are also Prone.

damageOrder: Add up all remaining dice, damage bonuses, and damage modifiers.
Add Weakness of the applicable damage type(s).
Subtract Resistance from the dice rolls of the applicable damage type(s).
Double the total if it was a Critical Hit.
Subtract Protection from the total (if applicable).
Deal damage to Temporary Hit Points (if applicable).
protectionSteps: If the Zone is Exposed, its Protection is 0; you can stop here.
Start with the Protection of the piece worn there. No piece worn means 0.
Add any bonus that applies to that Zone (a matched harness adds 1 to your Torso; some Talents add to every Zone).
Subtract 1 if the incoming damage type is the one that piece's material turns poorly. A Zone with no armor has no material, and so has no such weakness.
Subtract any Protection the attacker ignores.
recovery: Your Dying ends. You are conscious, on your feet if you spend an action to stand, with 1 Hit Point.
Your Dying value drops by 1. If it reaches 0, your Dying ends and you are stable: still unconscious, but no longer sliding.
chargenSteps: Your body and blood. This forms the core of your Origin Constellation and gives you starting Hit Points, Speed, and unique characteristics.
Hit Points per level, Size, Speed, and 1 Special Ability.
Your lineage. This adds a branch to your Origin Constellation and gives you additional unique characteristics.
Where you were raised. This adds a branch to your Origin Constellation.
Starting language(s), and a bonus to Diplomacy checks with those who share your Culture.
Your trade. This grants 1 Lore Talent Point and 2 Skill Talent Points.
Your adventuring identity. This adds special techniques such as entering a rage or sneak attacking.
Training in one Skill or other Constellation.
Your defensive posture (Awareness, Evade, Guard, and Endure).
Comets, which are Talent Points that can be used for any purpose (as long as you still meet the prerequisite).
